about.en: City Rub's site says the room is at 118 Stockton Street in the Ironbound, in the old Tio Pepe, with Southern food, a sports bar, a parking lot, and takeout. Phone (862) 237-7528. Email info@cityrub.com.
about.es: El sitio de City Rub dice que el local está en 118 Stockton Street, en el Ironbound, en el antiguo Tio Pepe, con comida del sur, bar de deportes, estacionamiento y comida para llevar. Teléfono (862) 237-7528. Correo info@cityrub.com.
about.pt: O site do City Rub diz que a casa fica na 118 Stockton Street, no Ironbound, no antigo Tio Pepe, com comida do sul, sports bar, estacionamento e retirada. Telefone (862) 237-7528. E-mail info@cityrub.com.

details.en: Cityrub.com lists a City Premium Package at $55 a person, plus 18% gratuity and 7% tax. Parties run 4 hours, family style. Children 0 to 5 are no charge, 6 to 12 are half, and over 12 are full price. Email info@cityrub.com or call (862) 237-7528.

details.pt: O cityrub.com lista um City Premium Package a $55 por pessoa, mais 18% de gorjeta e 7% de imposto. As festas duram 4 horas, estilo família. Crianças de 0 a 5 não pagam, de 6 a 12 pagam metade, e acima de 12 pagam inteiro. E-mail info@cityrub.com ou (862) 237-7528.
